ConversationPost.description: One earlier post of the conversation.
ConversationPost.title: ConversationPost

MentionContext.description: The minimum of the conversation needed to understand the post.

inicio_hilo.description: Text of the first post of the conversation (anonymised). None when the mention is itself the first post, or the first post was not available.
inicio_hilo.title: Inicio Hilo

responde_a.description: Text of the post this one directly answers (anonymised). None when the mention is not a reply, or when the post it answers is the first post (then it is in inicio_hilo).
responde_a.title: Responde A

MentionContext.title: MentionContext

description:
One post that talks about one watched drug, as the crawler hands it to triage.

Contract between the crawler and triage (``crawler/CONTRATO_TRIAJE.md``). Not judged: it
may or may not describe an adverse reaction; deciding that is triage's job.

id.description: Stable id of the mention, 'M-' + 10 hex chars, hash of (post_id, farmaco). The same post and drug always give the same id: use it to drop duplicates.
id.title: Id

fuente.description: Social network the post comes from.
fuente.title: Fuente

post_id.description: Pseudonymous stable id of the post ('p' + 12 hex chars). It is a hash: it does not identify the author and cannot be turned back into a link.
post_id.title: Post Id

hilo_id.description: post_id of the first post of the conversation. Mentions with the same hilo_id belong to the same conversation (they may describe the same case).
hilo_id.title: Hilo Id

farmaco.description: Watched active ingredient the post talks about, lower case, as in crawler/config.py WATCHLIST (e.g. 'sertralina'). A post about two drugs gives two mentions.
farmaco.title: Farmaco

tipo_mencion.description: How the post refers to the drug: nombre (active ingredient), marca (brand), errata (misspelt or shortened), indirecta (does not name it; known from the conversation), jerga (describes it without naming it).
tipo_mencion.title: Tipo Mencion

texto.description: Full text of the post, copied from the source (never written by a model) and anonymised: @handles -> '@usuario', links -> '[enlace]', e-mails -> '[correo]'.
texto.title: Texto

conversacion.description: Every post from the first one of the conversation down to the one this post answers, oldest first (the post itself is not included: it is in texto). Empty if the post is the first one. Lets triage read deep reply chains whole (added in 1.1).
conversacion.title: Conversacion

conversacion_completa.description: False if a post of the chain was not available (deleted, blocked or outside the sample): then conversacion starts at the oldest available post.
conversacion_completa.title: Conversacion Completa

idioma.description: Language declared by the author in Bluesky (ISO 639-1, e.g. 'es').
idioma.title: Idioma

fecha.description: When the post was published, ISO 8601 in UTC.
fecha.title: Fecha

encontrado_por.description: busqueda_fija: the post contains the name, a brand or a known misspelling (almost always right). agente: the crawler agent read the conversation and decided it talks about the drug (indirect mentions; about 1 in 4 is not really about it).
encontrado_por.title: Encontrado Por

motivo.description: Why it was saved (e.g. "contiene 'sertralina'"); may be empty.
motivo.title: Motivo

guardado.description: When the crawler saved it, ISO 8601 in UTC.
guardado.title: Guardado

title: RawMention
